test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some animals are plants.

2. Some plants are birds.

3. No duck is an animal.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some ducks are birds

(II) No bird is an animal.

(III) Some animals are birds.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b81f824aa6787f1c821cf3f4a4a8f150b15ec140c943e958947c11d9841f744e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some ducks are birds → Does not follow (As some animals are plants, some plants are birds and no duck is an animal. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) No bird is an animal → Does not follow (As some animals are plants and some plants are birds. As no direct relation is given between birds and animals, therefore it is false.)

(III) Some animals are birds → Does not follow (As some animals are plants and some plants are birds. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, None of the conclusions follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
